input.command:
clickhouse-client --query "
CREATE TABLE analytics.user_activity (
    event_id String,
    event_ts DateTime64(3, 'UTC'),
    user_id String,
    action LowCardinality(String),
    duration_ms Float32 DEFAULT 0
)
ENGINE = MergeTree()
ORDER BY (event_ts, user_id)
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(event_ts)
"
